identity: ONE original four-legged marsh beast, the Drowned Antler Sovereign, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter side view. Keep the muscular reptilian-canine body covered in moss-green layered bark and scales with a mossy mane and violet hanging roots, the narrow elk-like face, the enormous wide antler crown with small bone charms and chains hanging from its tines, four long legs ending in heavy broad cloven paw feet, and the long tapering foliage tail sweeping out to screen left. Exactly four legs and one tail. It is not a normal deer. Preserve the antler crown, charms, mossy armour and long body proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the whole antler crown, feet and tail tip within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, weapons, magic, glow, auras, impact effects, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the charms swing as secondary motion; do not morph the antlers.

idle_h3_v1.action: A regal, watchful idle that loops. The ribcage breathes, the great head turns slowly and dips the antler crown so the bone charms sway, one forefoot paws the ground once and the tail sweeps, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. The feet stay planted otherwise. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with a long stately stride. Diagonal pairs of legs alternate through reach, contact, push and lift; the elbows and knees articulate and each broad foot alternates taking weight and swinging. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel, the head bobs gently, the charms swing and the tail sways. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE antler thrust toward screen right. The beast bends its forelegs, lowers its neck and dips the antler crown as the hind legs coil, then drives its shoulders forward and thrusts the antlers low and forward to full reach at screen right, follows through briefly, then pulls the head back, raises the crown and settles into the original stance. One thrust only.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The head flinches up and back, the shoulders recoil and the near forefoot lifts off the ground, then the foot replants, the neck straightens and the beast returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Widen the forefeet, lower the neck and angle the antler crown forward like a barrier, then sink into a deep braced crouch on the forelegs guarding the chest beneath the crown and hold it on all four planted feet. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A solemn bow. The chest rises, the near forefoot lifts and reaches forward a little as the neck dips low with the antler crown presented forward, holds the bow briefly, then the foot replants, the neck rises and the beast returns to the original stance. The other three feet stay planted. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse continuously from standing: the legs buckle, the beast sinks onto its belly, the heavy antlered head sags to the ground and the tail goes limp, finishing lying motionless on its side and belly with the head and antlers resting on the ground at screen right and the tail at screen left. No recovery, no floating charms and no disappearing body.
